name: ShaluAI
what: ShaluAI is a landing page for a friendly everyday AI, told through a lamp on a shelf rather than a product screenshot. It invites visitors to say hello instead of selling features.
points: A large high-contrast serif wordmark in brown (#49372E) on a warm yellow wall with a faint patterned wallpaper, paired with DM Sans for the tagline.
The mascot is a smiling lamp on a book with a plant and a cup of chai, drawn with a hand-inked outline.
A handwritten "Hello" types itself out beside the lamp, and a small arrow points at the pull cord.
Pulling the cord (drag it down) turns the page into night: the wall goes deep purple, a window shadow appears, the lamp sleeps with Zs and says "Goodnight, you."
Clicking the lamp afterwards makes it wink and say "Just resting my..." in the same handwriting, so the toggle has a second small reward.

flow.caption: Day state with the cord hint and the Hello greeting typing in
Mid-drag on the cord: the lamp is already dozing and the wall darkens
Night state: lamp asleep, Goodnight, you.
